title: The Journey About page shows the course week by week, with its time, and no empty ring for a visitor

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: "Go through every element of the journey system and bring it up to best practice, fully evolved modern design." Follows JRN-021, JRN-022 and JRN-024.

detail: On /journeys/<slug> the head counted "4 phases · 12 lessons" where the course says weeks and steps and gave no sense of time, a visitor saw a 0% progress ring over "Up next", each week was a heading over a flat list, and a step ran its kind and name together under an unlabelled tile. The head now reads "4 weeks · 12 steps · about 2 hours". A visitor's hero says "It starts with · Overview" over the first step's name with no ring; a member's hero keeps the ring, names the next step's kind and shows the Journey week by week. Each week is the same card the course home draws (its number, a check once done, its step count and time), and a step leads with its name with its kind and time beneath.

verify.note: Fails on main: the body says Phase, lists weeks flat and draws the ring for every viewer.
